summary: Keystone Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO of 28,750,000 units at $10.00/unit ($287.5M gross), plus a private placement of 8,468,750 warrants at $1.00 each ($8.47M gross) to sponsor and underwriters. Net proceeds of $288.2M are placed in trust. This is a SPAC IPO—a blank-check company—following the standard SPAC trust structure. No business combination target is announced yet. Investors should watch for de-SPAC announcement within 18-24 months; risk includes dilution from warrants and sponsor promote.
